During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in a '''battle''' in the [[Dalcretti system/Legends|Dalcretti system]]. During the battle, an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] unit was cut off by Rebel forces. [[Demelza Mintori]]'s unit was unable or refused to provide assistance to [[Madrix Hansor]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]. The incident started a rivalry between the two that spilled over into their later careers as captains of [[gladiator walker]] sports combat teams.<ref name="GFT" />
